meta.title: KAYO — lodgings, tickets and routes in Japan
meta.description: A ticket-window for Japan: ryokan and machiya, reserved seats, plotted itineraries. English, Japanese and Chinese at the same counter.

brand.name: KAYO
brand.tagline: One counter for lodgings, tickets and routes.

home.headline: Put the lodging, the seat and the route on the same slip.
home.lead: KAYO is a desk, not a marketplace shout. We keep 7 houses, 8 tickets and 4 plotted routes on the board — numbers you can check, not a catalogue of everything in the country.
home.photoCaption: Kyoto Station concourse, morning. The window opens at 9:00 JST.
home.boardLead: Eight services. Times are first and last departures, Japan Standard Time.
home.housesTitle: Houses we will actually put you in
home.housesLead: Not a tower with a smiling lobby. Rooms with a walk time to a named station.
home.routesLead: Each one states what it leaves out. Furano lavender is July; this is written down.
home.notesTitle: Notes from people who used the window
home.notesLead: Four voices. We do not buy reviews.

hotels.title: Lodgings
hotels.lead: Ryokan, machiya, a canal business hotel, an onsen, a Sapporo lodge, a Naha guesthouse. Walk minutes are measured, not “close to the station”.
hotels.empty: Nothing on the board for that city. Clear the city, or pick another.

tickets.title: Tickets
tickets.lead: Shinkansen, a Romancecar, two domestic flights, a JR ferry. Where the national JR Pass does not apply, we say so on the row.
tickets.empty: No service on that path. Reverse the stations, or clear one end.

routes.title: Routes
routes.lead: Four itineraries with night counts and a price for two adults, lodgings plus ordinary reserved seats, unless the page says otherwise.
routes.empty: No route of that length on the board.

book.title: Reservation slip
book.lead: This holds the room or the seat. It is not a charge. The house or the railway still confirms.
book.name: Name as in the passport
book.notesPh: Large suitcase, late train, no fish…
book.error: The slip did not take. Check the name, the mail, and the dates.

booking.title: Held at the window
booking.lead: Show this reference at the house or keep it for the ticket. Status is held, not paid.

desk.title: The desk
desk.lead: A short clerk’s memo. Not a slogan.
desk.hours: Window hours 9:00–21:00 JST. After that, the night note.
desk.p1: A catalogue of 7 houses, 8 tickets and 4 routes, kept in PostgreSQL, shown in Japanese, English and Chinese. We do not scrape the whole country. If a house is on the board, someone here has the walk time in minutes.
desk.p2: The national JR Pass does not cover Nozomi or Mizuho. Hikari, Sakura, Kagayaki and the Miyajima JR ferry are written as such on each ticket. Do not buy a Pass for a Nozomi-only plan.
desk.p3: Suica and PASMO (east), ICOCA (west), Kitaca (Sapporo). They do not pay the Shinkansen reserved seat. The Osaka house can charge ICOCA at the desk.
desk.p4: Yamato Takkyubin from a convenience store takes a day on Honshu, longer to Okinawa. If you stay at Sugi-yu in Hakone, write that you have a large case — the last stretch is stone steps.
desk.p5: Japanese is the working language of the window. English and Simplified Chinese are written as full sentences, not calques. Traditional-character readers will still follow the Chinese pages; proper names stay in the Japanese forms (金沢, 那覇).

footer.copy: KAYO desk. Catalogue figures are yen, tax in, for the night or the seat as written.
footer.note: A booking here is a hold. Rail and houses confirm separately.

amenities.english_desk: English at the desk until the hour written
